card_title: My Never-Paste List (and How to Use Private Chats)
card_desc: What I never paste into ChatGPT or Claude, plus how to start a private chat in both.
meta_title: What Never to Paste Into ChatGPT or Claude (Free List) | Olivia Porter
meta_description: My never-paste list for AI chats: passwords, financial and tax ID numbers, client names in contracts, and employee HR details. Plus how to use private chats in ChatGPT and Claude.
sub: If you wouldn't put it on a billboard, don't put it in your chat.

steps.title: The never-paste list
steps.text: Keep these out of ChatGPT, Claude, and every other AI chat:
list: Bank, card and tax ID numbers.
Client names in contracts. Swap in Client A, Client B.

sections.label: Private chats
sections.title: How to turn on private chats

steps.title: Start a private chat
steps.text: A private chat isn't saved to your chat history:
list: In ChatGPT, click Temporary Chat at the top of a new chat.
In Claude, click the incognito (ghost) icon at the top of a new chat.

closing: A private chat still isn't the place for anything on the never-paste list. My rule: if you wouldn't put it on a billboard, don't put it in your chat.
